steps.description: Ordered array of actions to execute sequentially

action.description: Tool action name (e.g. reload_extension, set_extension_enabled, reload_tab, wait, capture_page_screenshot, get_live_dom_snapshot, interact_with_element)

stopOnError.description: Whether to abort subsequent steps if this step fails (default: true)

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save consolidated JSON report of all pipeline steps

expectedBehavior: Executes a two-step interaction pipeline over the live DOM
